The purpose of the present invention is to improve semiconductor integrated circuit reliability. A semiconductor integrated circuit (40) comprises: a first conduction-type semiconductor layer (1c) provided upon a support substrate (1a) via an insulation layer (1b); a second conduction-type first well region (2) provided at a distance from the insulation layer (1b), in an upper section of the semiconductor layer (1c); a first conduction-type second well region (3) provided in an upper section of the first well region (2); and a first conduction-type separated region (5) provided so as to surround the first well region (2) in an upper section by the semiconductor layer (1c), said separated region (5) being separated from the first well region (2) and the insulation layer (1b).

Semiconductor integrated circuitTechnical field

The present invention relates to a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit, more particularly to one kind are efficiently applied to be driven switch element The semiconductor integrated circuit such as high withstand voltage IC technology.

Background technology

Mainly in the inverter of low capacity, by switch element of high withstand voltage IC (HVIC) to power converter bridge circuit It is driven.In general high withstand voltage IC possesses high-end (high side) drive circuit, low side (low side) and drives electricity Road, level shifter (level shifter), control circuit etc..And, high withstand voltage IC is according to the letter being input into from input terminal Number, the gate turn-on for making switch element, the drive signal for ending to be driven are exported from lead-out terminal.In power converter bridge In circuit, receiving the switch element of the high side circuitry of the signal from high withstand voltage IC carries out action, thus carries out power converter.

The high-end drive circuit being driven to high side circuitry is by the p-channel as insulated-gate type field effect transistor CMOS (complementary type MOS) circuit that MOSFET and n-channel MOSFET are formed by connecting in a complementary fashion is constituted.P-channel MOSFET It is formed in the N-shaped well region on the top for being arranged at p-type semiconductor substrate.N-channel MOSFET is formed in the top for being arranged at N-shaped well region P-type well region.High-end drive circuit on the basis of VS current potentials current potential, with VB current potentials as power supply potential carrying out action, based on from The signal that level shift circuit is received comes from lead-out terminal output drive signal.VB current potentials are applied to the highest of high withstand voltage IC Current potential, under usual state not affected by noise, by boottrap capacitor etc. 15V higher than VS current potential or so is retained as. VS current potentials are the defeated of the tie point between high side switching elements and low-side switch element as power converter bridge circuit The current potential in egress portion, changes in 0V during power converter between hundreds of V, and negative current potential is changed into when also.

In this high withstand voltage IC, the various noises produced due to the action of switch element are transfused to sometimes, therefore In the design of high withstand voltage IC, realization tolerate the noise with do not cause misoperation, the noise tolerance of akinesia, so that it is guaranteed that High reliability is critically important.In order to improve noise tolerance, the action for suppressing parasitic antenna is needed, particularly, suppress high-end electricity The action of the parasitic antenna being longitudinally formed along substrate of (high side switching elements drive circuit periphery) immediately below the formation area of road is Critically important.This is because, the parasitic antenna area of substrate longitudinal direction easily flows through high current greatly.

It is an object of the invention to provide the technology that a kind of reliability that can realize semiconductor integrated circuit is improved.
